mentions.name: Personal Town Blog Website
mentions.description: A personal blog website built as the author's own small town, where they can put anything they want, including many houses representing the places they want to have.
mentions.audience: The author, for personal use as their own place on the web
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm doing on my personal town blog website. I want to have a place that is my personal town. I can put anything on it, like a small town with many houses that I want to have.
